choices.text: Tell me about the big oak.

nodes.text: Blaze cut low on the trunk means take it. No blaze means it's still working. The stand knows what it can spare better than either of us, and I just write down its answer.
Went in the year I was born, by the hut there. My mother planted it the week she couldn't lift a spade anymore, out of spite at the idea. We're neither of us done growing.
